_readme: This is the file the analyst edits. build_strategy.py turns it into
same discipline as decisions.json -> assumptions.json in
Delete every _readme and _comment key before building; they are ignored, but
they make the file harder to read once it is real.
scope_status  IN_SCOPE, or OUT_OF_SCOPE for a bank / NBFC / insurer.
economic_archetype must be a key from archetypes.py. If nothing in the
validated library fits, leave economic_archetype null and write your candidate
into proposed_archetype — that caps modelability at AMBER and asks the analyst
to sign it off. Do NOT invent a key.
materiality_pct is the segment's share of consolidated revenue in the base
year. Segments below 10% should normally be folded into the consolidated
build rather than carrying their own architecture.
business_description: One paragraph, from the knowledge base, on how this company actually earns revenue. Not the boilerplate 'about us'.

segments.name: Projects
segments.materiality_basis: FY26 segment revenue, annual report segment note

evidence.quote: unexecuted order book of INR 12,480 cr as at 31 March 2026
order inflow of INR 5,900 cr during the year
orders typically execute over 30 to 36 months
The Projects segment undertakes turnkey EPC contracts

model_architecture._comment: revenue_model is inferred when omitted. required_schedules are added automatically from each archetype; anything listed here is kept as well.
model_architecture.segment_modeling: Both segments modelled separately; central costs held outside and carried as unallocated.
model_architecture.consolidation_method: sum of segment revenue; segment EBIT margins weighted to a consolidated margin; unallocated corporate cost as a separate line

_declared_unsupported_note: Free-text requirements the existing financial-model genuinely cannot execute. Any entry here forces RED and makes every downstream skill refuse. Use it rather than approximating.

valuation_methods.rationale: Positive and forecastable operating cash flow with identifiable capital requirements; the order book gives visibility over the explicit forecast period.
Positive EBITDA and four listed comparables of similar capital intensity.
Earnings are positive but leverage differs materially across the peer set, which reduces comparability.
Asset-based valuation does not reflect the economics of an operating EPC and products business; the balance sheet does not carry the order book, which is where the value is.

uncertainties.issue: Segment EBIT margin is disclosed only for the last two years
uncertainties.impact: The Projects margin path is anchored on a two-point history
uncertainties.required_resolution: Pull the segment note from FY22-FY24 annual reports, or accept a consolidated margin and say so

rationale: Both segments have disclosed drivers and a validated architecture
